_help: Copy to reminders.json (done automatically on first run). Every direct sub-folder of each projects_roots entry is a project. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_ignore: Folders that are not projects. Backup copies like 'myapp_backup_2026-09-15' are skipped automatically when 'myapp' exists.
_track: Force-track a folder that would otherwise be ignored or treated as a copy.
_done: Finished or abandoned projects: never remind.
_snooze: Pause until a date (reminders resume ON that date), e.g. {"myapp": "2026-10-01"}.
_notes: Optional context the AI uses when suggesting a next step, e.g. {"myapp": "waiting on API keys from client"}.
